classification.difficultyReason: Classification by marks only. The rhombus drawn like a parallelogram and the isosceles trapezium with equal legs need care. Otherwise it is recall of definitions.

content.prompt: Identify the special quadrilateral as a parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, or kite.

answer.worked: Rhombus: all four sides have the same equality tick.
Trapezium: it has one pair of parallel sides. The equal sloping sides do not make a second parallel pair.
Kite: the ticks show two pairs of adjacent equal sides.
Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides are marked parallel.
